expert-tracking.description: Clube agent: Specialist in marketing attribution, Meta Pixel & Conversions API (CAPI), GA4, root-domain cookie hygiene, and database acquisition persistence.

expert-privacy.description: Clube agent: Specialist in LGPD/GDPR compliance, PII masking, shape logging, Sentry scrubbing, telemetry hygiene, and read-only audit logging.

expert-performance.description: Clube agent: Specialist in fullstack performance, SPA chunk recovery, CDN edge caching headers, container cgroups runtime tuning, and database query optimization.

clube-auditor.description: Clube agent: 360-degree audit coordinator executing deterministic Python detectors, parsing .clube/audit-last.json, and synthesizing 4-phase remediation reports.

reviewer.description: Clube agent: Read-only code review agent evaluating diffs for correctness, error handling, performance, security surface, test quality, and conventions, loading language-specific rules (Go, TypeScript, Rust) only when detected.
